scenes.line1: How does a browser turn code into pixels?
scenes.say: Ever wonder how browsers turn your code into what users see? Let's break down the critical rendering path.
First, HTML is parsed into the Document Object Model. CSS is parsed into the CSS Object Model. The browser combines these into a render tree, calculates layout, then paints pixels.

scenes.label: Optimize
scenes.sub: Speeding up these steps means faster first paint.
scenes.say: Optimizing the critical rendering path means your page loads faster and users see content sooner.

scenes.question: Is JavaScript parsed before painting?
scenes.right: Only render-blocking JavaScript is parsed before painting; async scripts can wait.
scenes.say: Here's an interview trap: Is JavaScript always parsed before the browser paints? Only render-blocking scripts are. Async scripts can wait.
